overall_assessment: Extraction works well for HiOF: the plan (facts box, content, learning outcomes, teaching, requirements, assessment, evaluation, literature) is captured completely and cleanly structured on all 28 pages; the only uncaptured text is the breadcrumb. The one real problem is that for some offerings the URL (year in path) returns a page for a later year, so the text is the wrong year's plan.

findings.description: The HIØ Videre pages for 2019 vår and 2022 høst show the plan for a later year (title says Vår 2020 and Høst 2023; the literature line even says 'Gjeldende litteraturliste for 2023 Høst'). The offering is 2018/19 and 2022/23, so the extracted text is another year's plan, served under the requested year's URL. The LSKNO22215 page also has a different course title (Litteraturhistorie og litteraturformidling) than the offering (Språk, litteratur og didaktikk), suggesting the course was renamed or replaced. The pre-pass 'year' flags are real in both cases.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The /studier/emner/videre/{year}/{sem}/ URL pattern resolves to the nearest/newest available plan for HIØ Videre courses instead of returning 404, so the year in the path is not honoured; the extraction itself is faithful.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a year check in the HiOF fetch/post step: compare the year in the page title '(Vår/Høst YYYY)' with the offering's term and mark or drop offerings whose title year is later than the offering (treat as no plan for that course-year). Also add the course-title mismatch as a warning.

findings.evidence: Sist hentet fra FS (Felles studentsystem) 17. okt. 2026 07:09:49
findings.description: Every page ends with a 'Sist hentet fra FS' line with a retrieval timestamp (2026), which is system boilerplate rather than plan text; the date also differs per fetch and can be mistaken for plan year. A similar structural label 'Innholdsfortegnelse' sits before the study-programme text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The selector includes the footer paragraph inside .entry-content / #vrtx-fs-emne-content; the timestamp varies so it is not removed as recurring chrome.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an exclude or post_fn regex for '^Sist hentet fra FS.*$' (and optionally the lone 'Innholdsfortegnelse' heading) in the hiof entry of R/institution_config.R.
